iconLibrary.name: Lucide

flutter.usageNote: Each icon below maps 1:1 to a LucideIcons.<camelCase> constant, e.g. data-lucide="arrow-left-right" -> LucideIcons.arrowLeftRight
flutter.alternativePackage: lucide_icons_flutter — same icon set, different API surface; either works, pick one and stay consistent

iconLibrary.colorRule: icon color follows text color, or the tinted accent (e.g. blue-600) on a soft-tint chip background

note: iconsUsedPerCategory are the per-item icons a user picks when creating a custom group/category (e.g. 'zap' for utilities) — expose a small icon picker with at least this set, ideally the full Lucide set.
